clue.text: Not allowing for offers being made

parts.note: taken as written
bidding is the making of offers, as at an auction

explanation.surface: Someone refuses to let a sale go ahead while bids are coming in.
explanation.definitionFit: Forbidding something is refusing permission for it, so it means prohibiting.

clue.text: In truth many will get covered with grease

indicators.note: the first piece is wrapped round by the second, which encloses it

parts.note: fat is grease
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, taken as many

explanation.surface: Lots of people will end up smeared in grease, honestly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' only links; 'will get covered with' puts C inside FAT.
explanation.definitionFit: A fact is something known to be true, a piece of truth.

clue.text: Marine upset over the German excess

indicators.note: in a down entry one piece sits over the next
upset means knocked over and disordered, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: der is a German word for the

explanation.surface: A marine is annoyed about too much German.
explanation.definitionFit: The remainder is what is left over, the surplus beyond what is needed.

clue.text: Road up-time to make representation!

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: the M1 is a British motorway, often written MI in crosswords
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A road climbing over time creates a picture.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is the main motorway from London to the north of England.
explanation.definitionFit: An image is a likeness or picture, a depiction of something.

clue.text: Suspect calls about debt

indicators.note: the first word goes about the second, enclosing it

parts.note: to dub is to call or name
an IOU is a note acknowledging a debt

explanation.surface: Someone is shady when phoning about money owed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something doubtful or questionable is open to suspicion.

clue.text: It's most stylish to take meals in the home

indicators.note: the meal word goes in the home word

parts.note: a nest is a bird's home
to eat is to take meals

explanation.surface: Dining at home is the smartest choice.
explanation.definitionFit: Neatest is the superlative of neat, meaning tidy and smart in appearance.

clue.text: Lying article written by graduate

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
BEd, Bachelor of Education, is a graduate's degree

explanation.surface: A dishonest article penned by a recent graduate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lying' reads as dishonest, but it means lying down; 'written by' only joins the article to the graduate.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone lying down at rest, especially at night, is in bed.

clue.text: A shrub the gardener may well put to good use

definitions.meaning: a yellow-flowered bush of the pea family

definitions.text: the gardener may well put to good use
definitions.meaning: a long-handled sweeping tool for clearing paths of leaves

explanation.definitionFit: The bush shares its name with a sweeping brush, once made from its twigs.

clue.text: Worried after a visit to the hairdresser?

definitions.text: Worried after a visit to the hairdresser?

parts.words: Worried after a visit to the hairdresser?
parts.note: upset in mind, but read as having had the locks of hair removed

explanation.definitionFit: Upset and anxious, but also read as stripped of tresses, which are long locks of hair.

clue.text: The way a board may be presented

parts.note: ST, street, is a way
a table is a board, as in board and lodging

explanation.surface: A description of how a plank could be displayed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that can be stated can be put forward or declared.

clue.text: Pause in mid-sentence

parts.note: a punctuation mark telling the reader to break briefly partway through a sentence

explanation.definitionFit: This punctuation mark marks a short break inside a sentence, unlike the full stop at its end.

clue.text: Appealing for reform, see about encompassing the most acceptable

indicators.note: the reshaped letters surround and enclose the next piece
to reform something is to reshape it, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
U stands for upper-class, the socially acceptable usage

explanation.surface: A plea for change, asking someone to look into the most acceptable option.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for reform' rearranges SEE and ABOUT; 'encompassing' then wraps those letters around U, the old label for upper-class, socially acceptable usage.
explanation.definitionFit: Something beauteous is lovely to look at, so it is attractive and pleasing.

clue.text: Feel a yearning about one for a certain tree-fruit

parts.note: to pine is to long for something
C is short for circa, Latin for about
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone longs for a particular fruit from a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The woody seed case of a conifer is the fruit borne by that tree.

clue.text: Give up backing the guy who counts the seconds

definitions.text: the guy who counts the seconds

indicators.note: backing means going in reverse, so the word is read from right to left

parts.note: to remit is to give up or hand over, as a debt or a claim

explanation.surface: A man who keeps time is told to retreat and surrender.
explanation.definitionFit: One who keeps time, as at a race or a boxing match, watches the clock and counts off seconds.

clue.text: The seat of government was nothing out of the ordinary

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: out of its usual order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A politician claims the capital was unremarkable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of the ordinary' rearranges NOTHING to give HINGTON.
explanation.definitionFit: The US capital is where the federal government sits.

clue.text: Making a note to prepare a speech

parts.note: D is a note of the musical scale
to dress is to prepare, as with a salad or a chicken for the oven

explanation.surface: A speaker jots something down to get a talk ready.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Making' and 'to' only join the pieces; the first 'a' gives A, and the second 'a' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal talk given to an audience is called by this name.

clue.text: Basis for action

parts.note: action read as a lawsuit: what grounds one in court

explanation.definitionFit: Proof and testimony are what a legal case rests on.

clue.text: Thanks would be given by minstrels for such clothing

parts.note: ta is informal British for thank you
bards are poets and singers, like minstrels

explanation.surface: Travelling singers express gratitude for some garments.
explanation.walkthrough: TA is everyday British slang for thank you.
explanation.definitionFit: A tabard is a short sleeveless tunic, worn by heralds and knights, so these are garments.

clue.text: Vacation no one returns after makes for hard times

indicators.note: the reversed piece comes after the break word

parts.note: a recess is a break or holiday, as of parliament

indicators.note: returns means goes back, so these letters are read in reverse

parts.note: taken as written
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A holiday no one comes back from leads to a slump.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' turns NO and I into ION, which goes after RECESS.
explanation.definitionFit: An economic slump of falling trade brings difficult times.

clue.text: An annoying bird?

parts.note: a bird of prey whose name also suggests one who keeps pestering

explanation.definitionFit: This hawk's name also means one who harries, that is, keeps harassing or annoying others.

clue.text: Push a liveried servant into destructive behaviour

parts.note: to ram is to push forcefully
a page is a boy servant in uniform

explanation.surface: Shoving a footman leads to wild violence.
explanation.definitionFit: A rampage is a spree of violent, destructive conduct.

clue.text: Sweet stuff will be found in the centre-a clear liquid

indicators.note: the answer lies within the run of clue letters that follows

explanation.surface: Something sugary sits at the core of a transparent fluid.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across the hyphen: cen-TRE-A CLE-ar.
explanation.definitionFit: Golden syrup and molasses are sugary syrups, so this is a sweet substance.

clue.text: 25% of a greedy beast's support

parts.note: a pig, the greedy beast, stands on four feet, so one foot holds up a quarter of it

explanation.definitionFit: A pig's foot is one of the four that bear its weight.

clue.text: Cultivating a vine is simple

indicators.note: cultivating works the ground over, so these letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Growing a grapevine is easy.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone artless and unsophisticated is simple in their outlook.

clue.text: Ernie could be the making of her!

indicators.note: making something new out of these letters means rearranging them

explanation.surface: A man named Ernie might make a woman of her.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's name, so it can stand for a woman.

clue.text: Naturally there's no night-time illumination

parts.note: a night sky lacking the natural light given off by the satellite of the Earth

explanation.definitionFit: A night with no moon showing has no natural light in the sky.

clue.text: The inexperienced driver, if followed by fools, dawdles

indicators.note: the word for fools comes straight after the letter for the learner driver

parts.note: L, for learner, is shown on a learner driver's car
oafs are clumsy fools

explanation.surface: A learner driver trailed by idiots crawls along.
explanation.walkthrough: British learner drivers display an L plate.
explanation.definitionFit: To loaf is to idle or loiter, wasting time.

clue.text: Hash will be offered in the canteen

definitions.meaning: a dining hall, as in the armed forces

explanation.definitionFit: A muddle or botch is one sense; a forces dining room is the other.

clue.text: Keen to ditch a social worker

parts.note: a trench is a long narrow ditch
an ant is a worker in a social insect colony

explanation.surface: Someone eager to get rid of a welfare officer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' suggests a welfare job, but it is an insect from a social colony; 'ditch' reads as a verb but is a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Trenchant comment is sharp and incisive, like a keen blade.

clue.text: Quick drink around tea-time

indicators.note: the drink goes around the time, enclosing it

parts.note: ale is a drink, a kind of beer
four o'clock is tea-time, and four is IV in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A fast drink taken in the afternoon break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quick' means living, as in 'the quick and the dead'.
explanation.definitionFit: In old usage the quick are those still living, as opposed to the dead.

clue.text: Bearing with a pressman causing distress

parts.note: NE, north-east, is a compass bearing
an editor, ED, is a newspaper man

explanation.surface: A journalist's demeanour is upsetting someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bearing' looks like conduct but is a compass direction; 'with' joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in need is to be in hardship or want, a state of distress.

clue.text: Objects to going around before shows

indicators.note: the first word goes around the second, enclosing it

parts.note: to resent something is to object to it
pre is a prefix meaning before

explanation.surface: Someone protests at circling ahead of a display.
explanation.definitionFit: To represent something is to depict or portray it, so it means displays.
